# Paper assets

Downloaded 2026-10-27. Distributed with 拾句.

- ten-bamboo.jpg: Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam. Briefpapier met bloemvaasje en waterpot, RP-P-1959-275-D(1), c. 1600–1699. https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/200404652 . The item is marked Public Domain. Reuse policy: https://data.rijksmuseum.nl/policy . Image endpoint: https://iiif.micr.io/bhxvW/full/1200,/0/default.jpg . The application samples the unpainted area and composites one feathered decoration near the bottom; it is not an unmodified facsimile.
- lokta.jpg: prabhasp, ali-khasro/lokta/paper1.jpg. https://github.com/prabhasp/ali-khasro . CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Author's license statement preserved in lokta-LICENSE-source.md. Brightened at runtime, mirrored to make a continuous tile. This is Nepali Lokta paper, not Chinese Xuan paper.
- Gold paper is generated by original application code; no external texture image is used.

- cloud.jpg: TextureCan Paper 0014, Chinese-style embossed cloud paper, https://www.texturecan.com/details/158/ . Runtime mix into ivory at 0.65^4 opacity (about 18%), matching the approved preview.
- newsprint.jpg: TextureCan Paper 0027, oxidized newsprint, https://www.texturecan.com/details/529/ . Runtime opacity 65% over ivory.
- kraft.jpg: TextureCan Paper 0023, slightly crumpled parcel paper, https://www.texturecan.com/details/463/ . Runtime opacity 65% over ivory.
- These three color maps are from the official 1K packages, licensed CC0 1.0. https://www.texturecan.com/terms/ explicitly allows modification, commercial use and redistribution with projects. Retrieved 2026-10-27. They are seamless procedural materials, not historical paper scans. No normal/roughness/height maps are shipped.
